import sys,time,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

while len(events)+2<=100000:
    events.append(['restore',0]); events.append(['dequeue',1])
run={'banks':1,'load_balancers':1,'fifo_bytes':2147483647,'pifo_bytes':8,
     'refill_batch':32,'sample_period':100000,'borders':[0,1],
     'policy':{'kind':'sff'},'events':events}
print('events',len(events))
t=time.time(); out=run_one(run); dt=time.time()-t
print('time',dt,'rows',len(out['log']),'live',len(out['state']['lags']))
